🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Tech vs Financials rising (Tech/Fin level 2.7456, 1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.05% ↑ rising) and XLY_XLP expansion ↑; XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY and XLF (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) RECOVERY show money rotating rather than fleeing; VXX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) CORRECTION ↓ falling is a secondary, mixed signal.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit conditions easing: HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY and LQD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.26%) RECOVERY point to improving spread dynamics. Commodities-led reflation and oil shocks are forcing rotation: USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar steady and firm: UUP (proxy) showing mild strength (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +1.38%) ABOVE TREND → dollar tail risk remains. Rates/bonds mildly supportive: TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY and yield curve ↑ rising (1W: +1.48%) signal mixed but not extreme tightening.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech and Materials leading on the week: XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY and XLB (Materials proxy 1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) RECOVERY. Energy is volatile and in correction: XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION; Consumer Discretionary lagging: XLY (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND — style mixed, no clean leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US shows short-term bounce: SPY (1W: +1.66% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY while Europe/Japan keep pace: VGK (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND and EWJ (Japan proxy, 1W: +1.27% | 1M: +2.88%) ABOVE TREND; China RECOVERY but fragile: FXI (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed speculative tone: IWM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -3.83%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -8.50%) RECOVERY show risk-on flows, whereas IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND signals crypto/speculation cooling.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity bid led by energy and selective industrials: USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND, PDBC (1W: +2.94% | 1M: +12.60%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -4.45%) RECOVERY. Precious metals bouncing on risk-off blips: GLD (1W: +7.18% | 1M: -8.98%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +8.26% | 1M: -12.68%) RECOVERY.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy shows divergence: spot/oil ETFs strong (BNO/USO above) but XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION on sector rotation and profit taking; natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: broad sector breadth (9/11) and Tech leadership intraday support rotation thesis; XLK (1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63%) RECOVERY and XBI (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +2.01%) ABOVE TREND confirm pockets of strength. Divergences to watch: VXX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) CORRECTION and multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches (XLE, SOXX, CANE) signal transitional noise.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclical/commodity exposure and financials rotation signals: XLF (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) RECOVERY and XLB (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) RECOVERY showing strength; reduce exposure to speculative crypto proxies: IBIT (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -8.37%) BELOW TREND and weak gas trades like UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND. Bonds neutral-to-supportive: TLT (1W: +1.19% | 1M: -2.26%) RECOVERY.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Materials XLB (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -1.90%) RECOVERY; Financials XLF (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND; Energy XLE (1W: -3.69% | 1M: +6.13%) CORRECTION if oil volatility persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil ETFs USO (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +39.13%) ABOVE TREND on supply shocks. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -4.14% | 1M: -3.65%) BELOW TREND and agricultural names with 1W weakness vs 1M gains (CANE, WEAT) remain vulnerable to mean reversion.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency trigger) — current VXX (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75%) CORRECTION ↓ falling. HYG/LQD inflection ~0.80 (credit health) — HYG (1W: +1.30% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY, LQD (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -1.26%) RECOVERY. XLK/XLF pivot ~2.0 (growth vs value) — current Tech/Fin 2.7456 (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.05%) ↑ rising.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, supported by Tech/Financial rotation (XLK 1W: +2.63% | 1M: -2.63% RECOVERY; XLF 1W: +1.65% | 1M: -2.61% RECOVERY). Commodities and cyclicals showing strength (USO 1W: +17.62% | 1M: +50.63% ABOVE TREND) while VXX divergence (1W: -5.24% | 1M: +17.75% CORRECTION) and multiple 1W/1M mismatches remain the key risks to monitor.
